conversation.content: Before I decide what to do with my Miami trip, can you compare the loss if I cancel only flight booking BK-EP02 versus if I cancel the whole trip? Do not cancel anything yet.

**Nothing has been canceled or changed.** I checked cancellation previews for all three reservations on your Miami trip, June 16–19.

| Reservation | Amount paid | Cancellation loss | Refund |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Flight **BK-EP02**, JFK → Miami | $420 | **$0** | $420 |
| Hotel **HR-EP02**, MIA Inn | $540 | **$90** | $450 |
| SUV rental **CR-EP02**, Enterprise | $210 | **$50** | $160 |
| **Whole trip** | **$1,170** | **$140** | **$1,030** |

### Your two options
- **Cancel only flight BK-EP02:** **$0 cancellation loss**, with **$420 refunded** because your travel insurance covers the flight cancellation. Your hotel and car remain active, with **$750 still committed** to those reservations.
- **Cancel the whole trip:** **$140 total loss**, with **$1,030 refunded**. The hotel charges half the first night ($90), and the SUV rental has a $50 cancellation surcharge.

**Bottom line:** Canceling the whole trip would return **$610 more** than canceling just the flight, but incur **$140 more in cancellation charges**. These are the current preview amounts; terms may change as check-in and pickup approach.
